name: Game Show Classics
description: What's My Line?, You Bet Your Life with Groucho Marx, I've Got a Secret, To Tell the Truth, Password, Concentration, Beat the Clock and Queen for a Day. What's My Line? airs weeknights at 7:30 pm.
curated: 2026-10-14: about 115 hours of 1950s-80s game shows matched by show title; board games and video games excluded.

sources.title: Classic game shows
sources.query: mediatype:movies AND title:("You Bet Your Life" OR "I've Got a Secret" OR "To Tell the Truth" OR "Truth or Consequences" OR "Beat the Clock" OR "Name That Tune" OR "Password" OR "Match Game" OR "Concentration" OR "Twenty One" OR "Queen for a Day") AND NOT year:[2000 TO 2030] AND NOT title:(trailer OR clip OR documentary OR game OR board OR pc OR nes OR snes) AND NOT title:(Nazi OR camp OR Holocaust OR Rosie OR movie OR Grams)

source.title: What's My Line?
source.query: mediatype:movies AND title:("What's My Line" OR "Whats My Line") AND NOT year:[2000 TO 2030] AND NOT title:(trailer OR clip OR documentary) AND NOT title:(Nazi OR camp OR Holocaust OR Rosie OR movie OR Grams)
